trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR — the whole prop + its five extracted tables were recomputed. VERIFIED CORRECT: [2]_q = q + 1/q = 2.0108968667 at the proton pin, so 2 + 1/[2]_q = 2.4972905456 and m_e(2+1/[2]_q) = 1.2761128 MeV (Table 1's 1.2761) and (5/2)m_e = 1.2774974 (Table 1's 1.2775). Table 2 is exact: for lambda ⊢ 3 the q-hook dimensions are dim_q(3) = dim_q(1,1,1) = 1 and dim_q(2,1) = [2]_q, so the inverse-dimension contributions 1, 1/[2]_q, 1 do sum to the boxed 2 + 1/[2]_q, and (2,1) is indeed the self-conjugate one. Table 3 reproduces to every printed digit at BOTH pins (they agree to 6 s.f. here): n=3 2.49729, n=4 3.14640, n=5 3.03053, n=6 3.20213; and the classical column is exact — 5/2, 19/6, 46/15 and 473/144 = 3.2847222 are the true sums of 1/d_lambda (n=6 checked partition by partition: 2 + 4/5 + 2/9 + 2/10 + 1/16). Table 4's arithmetic closes: 955.49/(1 + [2]_q hbar_q^2) = 936.9925 (printed 936.994), 938.272 - 936.994 = 1.278, 1.278/m_e = 2.50098 (printed 2.5009), 2.5009/2.5 = 1.00036. Table 4 also carries the required absolute-mass-excision disclaimer, correctly. DEFECT 1 (MAJOR, internal contradiction): this .md's 'This matches the observed proton residual to within 0.1%.' is false for the form it boxes. Recomputed, the q-deformed value misses by (2.4972905 - 2.5009)/2.5009 = -0.1443%, and TABLE 1 OF THIS SAME PROPOSITION ALREADY PRINTS -0.14%. Only the CLASSICAL 5/2 is inside 0.1% (-0.036%). Proposed: 'matches ... to within 0.15%', or state the two forms separately as Table 1 does. DEFECT 2 (minor, rounding direction): Table 1's classical row prints -0.03% for a value of -0.0360%, which rounds to -0.04% and is printed as 'sub-0.04%' in Table 4 — the same quantity given two ways. DEFECT 3 (minor, sweep damage): Table 5 row 1 reads 'Deuteron gap (the formal derivation)', a token substitution where a script name stood — the same corruption class already recorded in this chapter's sidecars (cl3-zeta5-geometric-realization.qa.json, borromean-bloch-group-element.qa.json) and visible in ~10 sibling files; note that row 2 of the same table keeps its name ('q-variants (q-variant-partition-sum)'), which is what makes row 1's parenthetical read as a hole. It survives to the earliest committed version of the file, so it cannot be recovered from history; the producer named in the .ts computation field is computations/proton_residual_rootcause.py. Table 5's other cell, 'within 0.1% of each other', is off by the same margin as DEFECT 1: classical 2.5 vs q-analogue 2.4972905 differ by 0.108%.
